task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand Kit → Screen Clips page is open with the Cursor Style control visible and unchanged

summary:
Navigated to where the cursor type (Cursor Style) is set, without altering any value since you only asked to be shown how.

Steps (brand-wide default, the broadest scope):
1. In the left sidebar, click "Brand Kit" (bottom of the sidebar).
2. In the Brand Kit nav column, choose "Screen Clips" — the pane titled "Screen Clip Settings" opens (it's currently showing).
3. Under the "Cursor" section, click the "Cursor Style" combobox (currently "Pointer-first").
4. Pick the style you want from the dropdown: "Arrow-first", "Pointer-first", or "Original". It applies immediately.

Nearby related cursor controls on the same page: Auto-Hide Cursor (Auto Hide / Off), Text Cursor (Hide / Show), and Cursor Scale (currently 1.60).

Note on scope: this Brand Kit page sets the default for the brand. To change the cursor style for just one project instead, open that project, click the "Project actions" ⋯ button next to the voice picker, choose "Screen Clip Settings…", change Cursor Style there, and click Done — that override is stored separately from the brand default. I left everything as-is (Cursor Style still "Pointer-first").
